details:
This update for psqlODBC fixes the following issues:

Changes in psqlODBC:

- Update to 18.00.0006:
  * Large-object read overflows the application buffer
    (CVE-2026-120057, bsc#1289252).
  * Row cache overflow when a later FETCH changes the column count
    (CVE-2026-120058, bsc#1289253).
  * Driver uses a server-supplied column name as a format string
    (CVE-2026-120059, bsc#1289254).
  * Driver does not validate server-supplied counts and lengths
    (CVE-2026-120060, bsc#1289255).
  * ODBC escape parser stack buffer overflow
    (CVE-2026-120061, bsc#1289256).
  * SQL injection through SQLSpecialColumns table and schema names
    (CVE-2026-120062, bsc#1289257).
  * Stack buffer overflow when quoting long schema and table names
    (CVE-2026-120063, bsc#1289258).
  * Driver does not validate column numbers and row indexes in
    binding and descriptor functions
    (CVE-2026-120064, bsc#1289259).
  * Driver does not escape a server-supplied column name in its
    updatable-cursor queries (CVE-2026-120065, bsc#1289260).
  * Log files are created with default permissions at a predictable
    path and follow symbolic links
    (CVE-2026-120066, bsc#1289261).
  * Stack buffer overflow when reading the keyset (ctid/oid)
    columns of an updatable cursor
    (CVE-2026-120067, bsc#1289262).
  * Hardening: SQLSetDescRecW stored a freed buffer and the address
    of a local variable as deferred bound data. It now stores the
    application's pointers, as SQLSetDescRec does.
  * Hardening: SQLColumns returned uninitialized relkind and table
    OID values when the table query returned no rows.
  * Hardening: convert_linefeeds could dereference a NULL pointer
    in one build configuration.
  * Hardening: secure_sscanf limits an over-wide %Ns width,
    msgtowstr checks for a zero buffer length, and the MSDTC
    connect-string append is bounded.
